## Participant Questionnaire

Please complete this short questionnaire before participating in the project. It helps us better understand your site, practices, and goals so we can tailor our work effectively.

**Vermont participants:** Please complete this form.

**New York participants:** Many of you have already completed a paper version, and we have most of your information on file. However, if you don’t mind filling out this online version as well, we would greatly appreciate it.
